SCENE sc_001 0-20100 INT. CASTLE DUNGEON STAIRWELL – NIGHT
EP29:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: High angle tracking shot descending a spiral stone staircase illuminated by flickering wall torches and damp, glistening masonry.
EP29:E2 0-3500 SOUND: Dripping water echoes hollowly against stone steps alongside the shuffling scuffle of boots.
EP29:E3 2800-5100 CAMERA: Tracking shot facing two stern uniform guards hauling a struggling Juliana down the dark corridor by her arms.
EP29:E4 2900-5100 ACTION: Juliana resists furiously, her feet stumbling on the wet flagstones as the guards forcibly propel her forward.
EP29:E5 5100-7400 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing regally under an arched stone doorway, clutching the leather-bound herbarium.
EP29:E6 7400-11700 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's tearful face as she reaches an arm out toward Catherine in anguish.
EP29:E7 7400-11700 JULIANA [Desperate, Weeping]: "Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!"
EP29:E8 11700-13200 CAMERA: Medium shot from behind Catherine as she stands motionless, watching Juliana being dragged away.
EP29:E9 13200-17300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana turning her head back toward Catherine, screaming through tears.
EP29:E10 13200-17300 JULIANA [Pleading, Agonized]: "It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!"
EP29:E11 17300-20100 CAMERA: Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.
SCENE sc_002 20100-83000 INT. DUNGEON CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
EP29:E12 20100-26800 CAMERA: Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.
EP29:E13 21000-24000 CATHERINE [Mocking, Condescending]: "Your mother's little book of weeds?"
EP29:E14 24800-26700 CATHERINE [Cruel, Smug]: "You still call this a legacy?"
EP29:E15 26800-28900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.
EP29:E16 27100-28700 JULIANA [Defiant, Furious]: "It is medicine!"
EP29:E17 28900-31900 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.
EP29:E18 30400-31800 CATHERINE [Smooth, Patronizing]: "Of course."
EP29:E19 31900-37400 CAMERA: Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.
EP29:E20 31900-37300 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Disdainful, Calculating]: "Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand."
EP29:E21 37400-40000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.
EP29:E22 37700-40000 CATHERINE [Icy, Threatening]: "The magistrate will call it witchcraft."
EP29:E23 40000-41900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.
EP29:E24 40100-41800 JULIANA [Furious, Shouted]: "You know that is a lie!"
EP29:E25 41900-44300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.
EP29:E26 42000-44200 CATHERINE [Calm, Sinister]: "I know exactly what I need him to believe."
EP29:E27 44300-46900 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.
EP29:E28 44400-46500 JULIANA [Screaming, Desperate]: "You cannot just destroy it!"
EP29:E29 46900-49800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.
EP29:E30 47300-49100 CATHERINE [Whispered, Malicious]: "I can burn it."
EP29:E31 49800-53600 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.
EP29:E32 50100-53600 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Chilling, Relentless]: "And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope..."
EP29:E33 53600-56600 CAMERA: Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.
EP29:E34 53800-56500 CATHERINE [Cruel, Resolute]: "...no one will remember what was written inside."
EP29:E35 56600-59200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana screaming back in raw outrage.
EP29:E36 56700-59000 JULIANA [Enraged, Defiant]: "You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"
EP29:E37 59200-63800 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her silk gown, contempt etched across her features.
EP29:E38 59300-63400 CATHERINE [Scornful, Arrogant]: "I am doing this because women like you forget their place."
EP29:E39 63800-67000 CAMERA: Quick pan from Juliana's apron up to Catherine's face.
EP29:E40 64500-66500 CATHERINE [Cold, Venomous]: "You were cast out once."
EP29:E41 67000-69500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's smiling lips and cold blue eyes.
EP29:E42 67200-69100 CATHERINE [Menacing]: "You should have stayed forgotten."
EP29:E43 69500-71800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana raising her chin, unwavering pride breaking through her tears.
EP29:E44 69800-71400 JULIANA [Steely, Resolute]: "My husband will find me."
EP29:E45 71800-74300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine letting out a scornful laugh, tilting her head.
EP29:E46 72100-74300 CATHERINE [Scoffing, Amused]: "Your scarred soldier?"
EP29:E47 74300-78500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into sharp mockery.
EP29:E48 74700-78100 CATHERINE [Derisive, Biting]: "What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?"
EP29:E49 78500-80900 CAMERA: Medium shot as the guard clamps a heavy hand on Juliana's shoulder, shoving her forward.
EP29:E50 78700-80600 GUARD [Gruff, Dismissive]: "Move along, girl."

EP29:E59 93700-96100 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's tear-drenched face crumpling in overwhelming grief.
EP29:E60 94200-95500 JULIANA [Sobbing, Heartbroken]: "Mother..."
EP29:E61 96100-99600 CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana pushes herself off the wet stone floor and dashes toward the barred wicket of the heavy door.
EP29:E62 97300-99500 JULIANA [Desperate, Shouting]: "I have done nothing!"
EP29:E63 99600-102500 CAMERA: Tight profile close-up of Juliana gripping the rusted iron bars, screaming out into the empty stone corridor.
EP29:E64 99700-102300 JULIANA [Screaming, Hysterical]: "I saved her! I healed her!"
EP29:E65 102500-105900 CAMERA: Medium shot from inside the cell as Juliana pounds her fists rhythmically against the reinforced iron door.
EP29:E66 102500-105200 SOUND: Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.
EP29:E67 102600-105300 JULIANA [Shouting in Anguish]: "I saved the Duchess!"
EP29:E68 105900-109000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.
EP29:E69 106500-108800 JULIANA [V.O.) (Sorrowful, Wounded]: "They took my mother's ledger..."
EP29:E70 109000-112800 CAMERA: Front medium shot of Juliana slowly rising to her feet, crossing her arms firmly across her chest as her tears stop and her expression hardens into steely resolve.
EP29:E71 109000-112600 JULIANA [V.O.) (Quiet Resolve, Unbreakable]: "They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me."
EP29:E72 112800-115500 CAMERA: Close-up of the dungeon's massive iron portcullis bars dropping down with finality.

EP29:E74 115500-116690 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana standing dignified in the center of the damp dungeon cell, gazing upward toward the overhead grate where faint beams of moonlight filter down, cutting sharply to black.

output.summary: Episode 29 (ep_029) on-screen events EP29:E1-EP29:E74 show Juliana dragged to the dungeon after Catherine seizes her mother's herbarium, threatens to burn it and frame her for witchcraft, and Juliana breaks down in the cell before vowing that they will not take Alexander from her. This analysis uses only on-screen event text. The metadata logline and continuity notes were not treated as evidence and no claims rely on them. Uncertainty: the identities and relationships of Alexander, the scarred soldier, Ashbrook, the magistrate and the unnamed him are not established on screen. Juliana's claims about saving the Duchess and about her husband are unverified assertions. Speaker tags at EP29:E20, EP29:E32 and EP29:E69 have malformed markup, though the speakers are evident from context.

characters.name: Juliana
characters.role: Protagonist, accused healer whose mother's herbarium is seized; claims she saved and healed the Duchess

characters.name: Catherine
characters.role: Antagonist who seizes the herbarium, threatens to burn it and plans to frame Juliana for witchcraft

characters.name: Guard
characters.role: Unnamed castle guard who restrains and moves Juliana to the cell

characters.name: Juliana's mother
characters.role: Deceased woman referenced as the author of the herbarium and ledger; not seen on screen

characters.name: Alexander
characters.role: Person Juliana says will not be taken from her; relationship unclear on screen

beats.description: Guards haul a resisting Juliana down a dungeon stairwell while Catherine stands under an archway holding the herbarium.
Juliana pleads for the herbarium as her mother's legacy; Catherine ignores her and turns away on the steps.
Catherine mocks the herbarium as weeds and dismisses it; Juliana insists it is medicine; Catherine says the magistrate will call it witchcraft.
Catherine states she will burn the book and implies Juliana will be hanged, saying no one will remember what was written inside.
Juliana says Catherine acts because she saved the Duchess; Catherine says women like her forget their place and reminds her she was cast out once.
Juliana declares her husband will find her; Catherine mocks her scarred soldier and asks what a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook.
A guard shoves Juliana down the corridor into a dark cell; she falls to the wet floor and the iron door locks.
Juliana hyperventilates, calls for her mother, pleads innocence and pounds the door, then slumps weeping against the wall while mourning the lost ledger.
Juliana rises, her tears stop and she vows they will not take Alexander from her as a portcullis crashes down and moonlight filters through the grate.

revelations.claim: Catherine states that Juliana was cast out once before.
creates_questions: Why was Juliana cast out and by whom?

revelations.claim: Catherine plans to have the magistrate label the herbarium as witchcraft and says she knows exactly what 'him' needs to believe.
creates_questions: Who is the him that Catherine intends to deceive?
Will the magistrate act on the witchcraft accusation?

revelations.claim: Juliana asserts that she saved and healed the Duchess, which she presents as the reason for Catherine's hostility.
creates_questions: Did Juliana actually heal the Duchess, and what was the Duchess's condition?

unresolved_questions.question: Who is the him that Catherine says she needs to believe the witchcraft accusation?
Why was Juliana cast out in the past, and what were the circumstances?
Who is Alexander and what is his relationship to Juliana?
Who is Juliana's husband and will he find her as she claims?
Who is the scarred soldier Catherine mocks, and is he the husband Juliana references?
What role does Ashbrook play, and will the penniless veteran challenge it?
Will the magistrate pursue the witchcraft charge and will the herbarium be burned?
What happened to the Duchess, and was Juliana's healing claim true?
